analysis.title: Americas Consumer Products: NielsenIQ data thru 10/17 - Total US Cosmetics $ sales growth decelerated slightly in the L-2wks as volumes decline
key_insights: Total US cosmetics dollar sales in NielsenIQ (incl Amazon 1P) grew +2.8% in the latest 2 weeks ending 10/17/26, vs +3.0% for 4 weeks and +5.5% for 12 weeks. Volume fell -2.5% (vs -0.9% / +2.4%) and price/mix rose +5.5% (vs +3.9% / +3.0%).
Face cosmetics dollar sales grew +6.2% in the L-2wks (vs +5.3% 4-wk, +7.3% 12-wk). Volume fell -0.8% (vs +0.9% / +5.1%) and was more than offset by price growth of +7.0% (vs +4.3% / +2.0%).
Eye cosmetics dollar sales grew +2.1% in the L-2wks (vs +2.9% / +5.8%), driven by price growth of +4.2% and partly offset by a volume decline of -2.1%.
Lip cosmetics dollar sales grew +0.1% in the L-2wks (vs +0.7% / +3.3%) as volume fell -4.0% (vs -2.2% / +0.6%). Lip is the weakest of the three cosmetics categories.
Fragrance dollar sales growth slowed to +1.7% in the L-2wks (vs +8.2% 4-wk, +14.9% 12-wk). Unit volume growth slowed to +6.2% (vs +11.4% / +20.0%) and pricing was -4.3%.
Facial skin care dollar sales accelerated to +10.0% in the L-2wks (vs +7.3% / +7.4%). Volume grew +4.7% (vs +3.7% / +7.1%) and pricing grew +5.0% (vs +3.4% / +0.3%).
Promotional levels were sequentially lower across all categories in the L-2wks except fragrance. Share of sales on promotion: eye 23.3%, face 19.9%, lip 22.5%, fragrance 27.6%.

ELF continues to outpace beauty peers: total sales +13.2% in the latest 2 weeks (vs +12.7% 4-wk, +14.6% 12-wk) on volume +12.5% and price +0.6%. ELF face cosmetics grew +6.6% on volume +12.7% and price -5.4%.
ELF lip cosmetics dollar sales fell -2.3% in the L-2wks (price -7.3%, volume +5.3%). ELF eye cosmetics grew +8.6%.

COTY total US sales fell -1.1% in the L-2wks (vs -2.1% 4-wk, +0.5% 12-wk). Volume fell -3.8% and pricing rose +2.8%. COTY eye cosmetics fell -6.6% and face cosmetics fell -1.9%, while COTY fragrance grew +5.6%.
L'Oreal US cosmetics: face cosmetics +8.7% in the L-2wks, with L'Oreal Paris face +23.1% and Maybelline face -3.5%. L'Oreal eye cosmetics grew +0.6% and lip -0.8%.
L'Oreal fragrance dollar sales rose +12.3% in the L-2wks, led by Azzaro (+63.1%). Yves Saint Laurent fell -17.9% and Valentino -14.4%.
Euroitalia (Versace) fragrance sales slowed to +6.5% in the L-2wks from +65.6% over 4 weeks.

MacAndrews & Forbes (Revlon, Almay) and Markwins (Wet n Wild, Physicians Formula) continued double-digit declines in face, eye and lip cosmetics. Markwins total cosmetics fell -14.9% and MacAndrews & Forbes fell -4.2% in the L-2wks.

Bloomberg Second Measure card data shows ODD's credit card sales flat y/y for the week ending 10/18/26 (vs -7% the prior week), with transactions +6% and average transaction value -6%. Il Makiage fell -36% while Spoiled Child grew +89%.
Card data suggests ODD Q3 sales were down -11.9%, below GS's estimate of -5.0%, and Q4-to-date sales are down -4.7%, above GS's estimate of -10.0%.

e.l.f. Cosmetics' card sales fell -43% y/y for the week ending 10/18/26 (vs +50% the prior week), driven by average transaction value of -26%. Naturium fell -33% and rhode grew +59% (vs -2% the prior week).
Card data suggests rhode growth of +15% in FQ3, vs GS's estimate of +12.5%.

market_movers.rationale: NielsenIQ total sales +13.2% in the L-2wks on volume +12.5% and price +0.6%, outpacing beauty peers. Weekly card data was volatile at -43% y/y.
NielsenIQ total sales -1.1% in the L-2wks, with volume -3.8% partly offset by pricing +2.8%. Eye cosmetics -6.6% and face cosmetics -1.9%.
Card data shows Q3 sales down -11.9% vs GS estimate of -5.0%, while Q4-to-date at -4.7% is above GS's -10.0% estimate.

sector_views.rationale: US cosmetics dollar growth of +2.8% in the L-2wks is price-led, with volume down -2.5%. Fragrance growth slowed sharply and skin care accelerated.

earnings_insights: ODD Q3 (card-data implied, not reported): Bloomberg Second Measure suggests net sales down -11.9% vs GS estimate of -5.0%.
ODD Q4-to-date (card-data implied, not reported): sales down -4.7% vs GS estimate of -10.0%.
rhode FQ3 (card-data implied): Bloomberg Second Measure suggests +15% growth vs GS estimate of +12.5%. rhode FQ2 growth moderated, directionally similar to GS's FQ2 estimate.
risk_factors: Cosmetics category volume is declining (-2.5% in the L-2wks) and growth depends on price increases.
Fragrance growth is decelerating from a high base (+1.7% in the L-2wks vs +14.9% over 12 weeks).
Weekly card data for e.l.f., Naturium and rhode is highly volatile week to week, which limits how much weight a single week carries.
